cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We've arrived at Queen Hospital.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: So this is Queen Hospital.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Are you sure, Randam? This will be dangerous.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: A one-in-ten-thousand chance of survival.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Then I'll expect a bigger bounty.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You're a strange one, you know that?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, let's start the investigation!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Look! There's paper stuck between the drawers.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They're empty otherwise.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Someone seems to have cleared them out in a hurry.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That paper?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Here it is.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What's this? Chinese? Read it for me, Metal.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. "Medical record. New patient."

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I don't understand the next five characters.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I've never seen characters like these.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I thought you were good at Chinese, Metal.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: My specialty is mahjong: riichi, tanyao, pinfu, dora one.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Unusual Chinese characters? Or a code?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's definitely part of a medical record.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: This code probably conceals a name.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: If we crack it, we'll identify a Snatcher.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: What happened to the other records?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Someone must have taken them before we got here.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I feel like the Snatchers know what we're doing.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: A Snatcher inside JUNKER? I'd rather not think about it.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll keep this piece of the medical record.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It seems to lead underground.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie was right. Queen Hospital has an underground level.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: And that's the Snatchers' nest. Right beneath us.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We're finally inside the belly of the beast. What will you do, Gillian?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The stairs are narrow. Let's go down in single file.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who's going first?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Obviously, the one with the light.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: That's not fair!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I know. Let's play rock-paper-scissors.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Fine. Rock-paper-scissors it is.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: But can you play, Metal?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Leave it to me. I'm prepared for anything at times like this.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: All right, a fair match. No cheating!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I promise. I'm a cop, after all.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You two are unbelievable. At a time like this!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: All right. Rock, paper, scissors!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Ha! I win!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Wait, wait, wait! That round doesn't count. Gillian didn't play.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Come on, Gillian! What are you doing? Play like a man!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Sorry, sorry.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Once more, a fair match!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Rock, paper, scissors!
